subject: MATHEMATICS
purpose: Release policy for source completeness. Completeness is three-layered and each layer failed independently during the seven-topic stress test, so each layer is gated independently.

layers.SOURCE_CORPUS_COMPLETENESS: every top-level source row is present
layers.ATOMIC_ASK_COMPLETENESS: every required subpart, proof obligation, option and parameter condition is present
layers.RENDERED_ASSESSMENT_COMPLETENESS: every stem, option, subpart and required context is visible after layout

evidence_from_the_stress_test: Number Systems: completeness relative only to the supplied question_set is self-relative, so an upstream omission goes undetected without an independent frozen manifest.
Polynomials: 72/72 top-level questions did not imply 151/151 atomic asks.
Linear Equations: all four options were present in the data while C and D were covered by the next panel on the rendered page.

occlusion_policy.rationale: A partially covered option is unusable to a learner, so the threshold is deliberately low; only paint-order-later opaque objects can occlude.

rendered_text_policy.rationale: Text that cannot be extracted from the rendered page is text a learner cannot read.

release_meaning: PUBLICATION_ENGINEERING only. A reconciled ledger is evidence that nothing was silently dropped; it is not a subject, pedagogy, assessment or expert-review PASS, all of which remain PENDING.
